description: Maximize your nursery storage with the Mackenzie 7 Drawer Dresser. Seven spacious dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide room for everything from newborn layettes to big-kid wardrobes. Crafted from solid hardwood in a warm Brown Maple finish, this dresser is built to last through every stage of childhood. The wide top comfortably accommodates a changing pad. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish. Coordinates seamlessly with the complete Mackenzie collection for a beautifully coordinated nursery.
